node.doctext:
Hi [Jagtig],

I understand your predicament, but please note that there are better forums to seek paid help. Quoting [id://504424]

No. PerlMonks is not to be used as a job board.

Job postings (either offering or looking for) should be posted to [http://jobs.perl.org|jobs.perl.org], which exists specifically for this purpose.

Regards,
-- Hauke D
